documents.title: 41St Annual General Meeting Of Antelopus Selan Energy Limited Is Schedule To Be Held On September 30, 2026 At 11Am Through Video Conferencing (VC)/ Other Audio Video Means (OVAM).
Announcement Under Reg. 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 - Award Of Contract Area To The Company

analysis.summary: Antelopus Selan Energy reported an average sales volume of 1,705 boepd in Q1 FY27 and achieved an EBITDA of Rs 93.2 crore with an EBITDA margin of around 70%. Management reiterated its guidance of reaching 2,500 boepd in FY27 as the Bakrol frac campaign begins to deliver productivity from Q2 onwards. The company submitted a 7-well FDP for the Karjisan field, planned a new well in Cambay for H2 FY27, and won two onshore licenses in DSF Bid Round IV. A temporary custody transfer timing issue resulted in a crude inventory build-up of ~6,500 bopd, which is expected to normalize in the next quarter. Antelopus Selan Energy Limited reported its FY26 annual results, highlighting average sales growth to 1,355 boepd and an exit rate of over 1,800 boepd.

guidance.claim: Antelopus Selan Energy maintained its target of reaching a production level of 2,500 boepd in FY27.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced strong quarter-on-quarter volume-driven growth alongside strong EBITDA growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Average sales volume for Q1 FY27 stood at approximately 1,705 boepd.

orders_capacity.claim: The exit rate for March 2026 was approximately 1,880 boepd.
